Package org.apache.hadoop.io.erasurecode

Class CodecUtil

java.lang.Object
org.apache.hadoop.io.erasurecode.CodecUtil
@Private public final class CodecUtil extends Object
A codec & coder utility to help create coders conveniently. CodecUtil includes erasure coder configurations key and default values such as coder class name and erasure codec option values included by ErasureCodecOptions. ErasureEncoder and ErasureDecoder are created by createEncoder and createDecoder respectively.RawErasureEncoder and RawErasureDecoder are are created by createRawEncoder and createRawDecoder.
